_comment: Word ceilings for standing docs — prose an agent is expected to trust in every session. Append-only logs (docs/ERRORS.md), audits, and working material are deliberately unbudgeted. See docs/doc-standard.md.
_purpose: These are anti-growth ratchets, not reduction targets. There is no goal word count. A ceiling exists so a doc cannot grow without someone noticing; when one goes red the answer is to move a section into its own file and leave an index line behind, never to delete a rule or drop a pointer. Raising a ceiling with a reason in the commit is a legitimate outcome.
